description.zh-CN: CloudTower 4.9.0 受控验收候选：物理盘 SMART 与每日历史、本地化和劣化风险；真实主机采集尚未验收。
description.en-US: CloudTower 4.9.0 controlled acceptance candidate: localized disk SMART, daily history and deterioration. Live host collection remains unverified.

compatibility.tower: CloudTower 4.9.0 controlled acceptance: API/DOM read checks and local tests; live host SMART unverified.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 0.1.3 本地受控候选：配置页全局手动采集与逐盘结果、失败后只读刷新；VMware/Virtual_disk 型号显示明确标注的本地示例，不混真实历史。依赖框架0.1.2，真实批次与示例尚未实机验收。
releaseNotes.en-US: 0.1.3 local controlled candidate: global collection in settings, per-disk results, and read-only reload after acknowledged failure. VMware/Virtual_disk models show clearly labeled local examples isolated from real history. Requires framework 0.1.2. Live batch and example acceptance is pending.

purpose.zh-CN: 每日采集已配置磁盘的 SMART 数据
purpose.en-US: Collect SMART for configured disks daily
